verses.restored: Sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Eleazar fathered Phinehas; Phinehas fathered Abishua;
Abishua fathered Bukki; Bukki fathered Uzzi;
Uzzi fathered Zerahiah; Zerahiah fathered Meraioth;
Meraioth fathered Amariah; Amariah fathered Ahitub;
Ahitub fathered Zadok; Zadok fathered Ahimaaz;
Ahimaaz fathered Azariah; Azariah fathered Johanan;
Johanan fathered Azariah, who served as priest in house Solomon built in Jerusalem;
Azariah fathered Amariah; Amariah fathered Ahitub;
Ahitub fathered Zadok; Zadok fathered Shallum;
Shallum fathered Hilkiah; Hilkiah fathered Azariah;
Azariah fathered Seraiah; Seraiah fathered Jehozadak;
Jehozadak went into exile when YHWH carried Judah and Jerusalem away by hand of Nebuchadnezzar, in narrator's theology.
Sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
Names of sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
Sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These were families of Levites according to ancestral houses.
Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.
Descendants of Kohath: Amminadab/Izhar his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, Shaul his son.
Sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
As for Elkanah's line: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
Sons of Samuel: firstborn Joel/Vashni, and second Abijah, according to textual witnesses.
Descendants of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
These are those David appointed over service of song in house of YHWH after ark had rest.
They ministered with song before dwelling of tent of meeting until Solomon built house of YHWH in Jerusalem; they stood according to their order.
These served with their descendants: from Kohathites, Heman the singer, son of Joel son of Samuel,
son of Elkanah, son of Jeroham, son of Eliel, son of Toah,
son of Zuph, son of Elkanah, son of Mahath, son of Amasai,
son of Elkanah, son of Joel, son of Azariah, son of Zephaniah,
son of Tahath, son of Assir, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah,
son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, son of Israel.
His brother Asaph stood on his right: Asaph son of Berechiah son of Shimea,
son of Michael, son of Baaseiah, son of Malchijah,
son of Ethni, son of Zerah, son of Adaiah,
son of Ethan, son of Zimmah, son of Shimei,
son of Jahath, son of Gershom, son of Levi.
Their brothers, descendants of Merari, stood on left: Ethan son of Kishi son of Abdi son of Malluch,
son of Hashabiah, son of Amaziah, son of Hilkiah,
son of Amzi, son of Bani, son of Shemer,
son of Mahli, son of Mushi, son of Merari, son of Levi.
Their Levite brothers were appointed for all service of tabernacle of house of Divine.
Aaron and his sons made offerings on altar of burnt offering and altar of incense, for work of most holy place and to make atonement for Israel, according to all Moses servant of Divine commanded.
These were sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
These were their dwelling places according to encampments within borders, for sons of Aaron from families of Kohathites, because first lot was theirs.
They gave them Hebron in land of Judah with surrounding pasturelands.
Fields of city and its villages they gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
To sons of Aaron they gave Hebron, city of refuge, Libnah with pasturelands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with pasturelands,
Hilen/Holon's pasturelands, Debir's pasturelands,
Ashan's pasturelands and Beth-shemesh's pasturelands;
from tribe of Benjamin: Geba with pasturelands, Alemeth with pasturelands, and Anathoth with pasturelands. All their cities throughout families were thirteen.
To remaining sons of Kohath, ten cities were given by lot from half-tribe of Manasseh.
To sons of Gershom by families, thirteen cities from Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.
To sons of Merari by families, twelve cities by lot from Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
Children of Israel gave Levites these cities with pasturelands.
They gave by lot from Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin these cities called by name.
Some families of sons of Kohath had cities from tribe of Ephraim.
They gave them Shechem in hill country of Ephraim, a city of refuge, with pasturelands, and Gezer with pasturelands,
Jokmeam with pasturelands and Beth-horon with pasturelands,
Aijalon with pasturelands and Gath-rimmon with pasturelands;
from half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner with pasturelands and Bileam with pasturelands for remaining Kohathite family.
To sons of Gershom from half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan with pasturelands and Ashtaroth with pasturelands;
from tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with pasturelands, Daberath with pasturelands,
Ramoth with pasturelands and Anem with pasturelands;
from tribe of Asher: Mashal with pasturelands and Abdon with pasturelands,
Hukok with pasturelands and Rehob with pasturelands;
from tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with pasturelands, Hammon with pasturelands, and Kiriathaim with pasturelands.
To remaining descendants of Merari from Zebulun: Rimmon with pasturelands and Tabor with pasturelands;
beyond Jordan at Jericho, east of Jordan, from Reuben: Bezer in wilderness with pasturelands and Jahzah with pasturelands,
Kedemoth with pasturelands and Mephaath with pasturelands;
from Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with pasturelands and Mahanaim with pasturelands,
Heshbon with pasturelands and Jazer with pasturelands.

translation_notes: Miriam is named beside Aaron and Moses, but later office lists become overwhelmingly male; her prophetic authority must not be erased.
Hereditary priesthood and assigned service describe an ancient institution, not universal permission for clerical caste, nepotism, or immunity from accountability.
Jehozadak's exile is imperial displacement. The narrator's Divine-agency language must not blame deported families for their own forced removal.
Samuel's sons in verse 28 have a major textual problem; Hebrew wording, Greek witnesses, and 1 Samuel parallels require audit.
Musicians, singers, gatekeepers, cooks, cleaners, treasurers, carriers, and other service workers sustain worship. Prestige should not obscure labor.
Atonement language belongs to Israel's ritual world and must not become coercive Christian supersessionism or contempt for Judaism.
Cities of refuge center protection from retaliatory killing; their purpose should not be lost inside property lists.
Ancient town allocations are not modern title deeds or permission to displace current residents.
City names and counts differ across Joshua, Chronicles, Hebrew manuscripts, and ancient translations.
safety_note: Do not use priestly genealogy to justify male supremacy, clerical immunity, caste, anti-Jewish theology, modern land seizure, or erasure of service labor. Sacred institutions remain accountable to the people whose work, land, food, music, and bodies sustain them.
